messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.36
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl2 (version 0.36) has been released on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available within a few days.

The changes are bug fixes:

  - Fixed a problem with sdp_panel=TRUE in plot_snpasso().

  - In scan1snps(), subset genoprobs and map to common positions, if they have different markers.

  - Stop index_snps() with an error if physical map has missing values.

Karl Broman
